user.title: Akce na pivo
user.description: Name the integration and pick a country. Czechia uses Czech deal sites (CZK), Slovakia uses Slovak ones (EUR). Add the integration twice for both.

settings.title: Akce na pivo – {country}
settings.description: Pick beer brands (or type your own and press Enter), deal sites, where to measure distance from and when to check the deals. Stores are looked up in OpenStreetMap within {country} only.

data.update_interval_hours: Additionally check every N hours (0 = daily only)
data.top_count: How many cheapest offers to show

data.price_alert: Alert when 0.5 l costs less than
